heading: 2026 regime applicability
text: Permendag 16/2026 establishes Indonesia's strategic natural-resource palm commodity export regime effective 2026-06-01. KMK 33/MK/BC/2026 provides the corresponding customs list of restricted goods. The corpus lacks a complete authoritative product/HS annex transcription. Do not conclude PKE is included or excluded until its precise BTKI code is matched to the operative annex.

heading: Customs export workflow
text: DJBC general export guidance describes goods preparation, supporting documents, PEB submission, risk-based physical examination when selected, document review, movement/loading and carrier departure. This general workflow does not replace commodity-specific restrictions or destination-country conditions.

heading: Classification and decision safeguards
text: Compliance assessment must preserve exact product identity, processing description, intended use, declared BTKI/HS code, origin, destination, shipment date and source version. If product classification or annex matching is unresolved, return PENDING_CLASSIFICATION or LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never a binary compliant/blocked result.
locator: PKE product classification and current export annex matching

heading: Separate food and feed regimes
text: GACC Decree 280 effective 2026-06-01 governs registration of overseas manufacturers of food for export to China and replaces Decree 248. Do not apply it automatically to PKE as an animal-feed ingredient; classify the product and intended use under the applicable feed rules and bilateral protocol.

heading: Imported feed registration candidate
text: MOFCOM's reproduction of Ministry of Agriculture Order 2014 No. 2 states that a foreign enterprise exporting feed/feed additives to China for the first time must obtain an import registration certificate before sale or use, with application handled through an in-China agent. The 2014 text has subsequent amendments and currentness is not reconciled; require current MARA legal verification before rule activation.
locator: MOA Order 2014 No.2 Articles 2-7 and 14; current consolidated text required

heading: Technical dossier evidence
text: MARA's 2013 guidance lists origin approval, composition and properties, manufacturing process, quality standards, samples from three batches and reports, intended use, label, packaging, storage and shelf-life data. The page says its English text is for reference and the Chinese original is authoritative; retain as historical guidance only pending current-law reconciliation.
locator: MARA Data Requirements for Registration of Imported Feed, 2013

heading: Fail-closed decision
text: For PKE shipments to China collect product category, intended use, producer/facility, country approval, importer/agent, registration evidence and bilateral protocol. If the applicable legal route is not verified, return PENDING_AUTHORITY_CONFIRMATION; do not infer a Decree 280 food registration obligation or claim feed registration is unnecessary.
locator: GACC Decree 280 and current MARA feed instruments

heading: Commodity identification
text: Pakistan TIPP identifies national tariff code 230660001000 as Palm Kernel Cake under HS subheading 230660. This is a Pakistan national tariff record and does not establish Indonesia's BTKI code or a binding classification for all PKE products.

heading: Import policy default and restrictions
text: Pakistan TIPP states imports are generally permitted from worldwide sources unless prohibited or restricted. The 2022 Order has repeated amendments, including 2026 instruments; shipment-date analysis must use the consolidated Order and every effective amendment.
locator: TIPP Import Policy Order 2022; Ministry of Commerce SRO index

heading: Displayed tariff snapshot
text: TIPP displayed 10 percent customs duty, 18 percent statutory sales tax and 12 percent income tax for tariff code 230660001000. Treat as a portal snapshot only; confirm current tariff year, exemptions, SROs, importer status and other levies with Pakistan Customs.

heading: No false restriction inference
text: The cited Import Policy Order restriction concerns certain animal-origin feed ingredients in defined BSE-risk situations. PKE is plant-derived, so do not apply that clause by analogy; other country-of-origin, quarantine and product-specific requirements still need official confirmation.
locator: TIPP Import Policy Order 2022 restrictions section

heading: Supply-chain scope
text: Codex CXC 54-2004 is the Code of Practice on Good Animal Feeding; the Codex catalogue shows a 2024 update. Its scope covers feed safety through procurement, handling, storage, processing and distribution of feed and feed ingredients for food-producing animals.
locator: Codex CXC 54-2004 official catalogue and PDF

heading: Operational use
text: Use Codex as a reference framework for supplier approval, material acceptance, segregation, handling, storage, process controls, traceability and distribution evidence. Convert controls into PKE-specific checklists only after technical and quality owners confirm applicability.

heading: Legal status boundary
text: Codex is an international standard-setting reference, not automatically a binding national import/export rule. Do not label a shipment non-compliant solely because a Codex recommendation is not represented in local law or contract.
